scientific_integrity: Self-contained proof with an exhaustive and independently cross-checked finite checker; no independent mathematical audit or comprehensive unpublished-priority determination has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The exact all-order transport identity applies only to sentinel-free cyclic BWT of binary de Bruijn cycles. The exhaustive joint distribution and sharp gap are for order five only. An all-order extremal gap is not claimed.
title: Bit-reversal transport of reverse Burrows–Wheeler transforms of de Bruijn cycles
